# ORVN Labs

> Brokerage intelligence infrastructure. PAS (Performative AI Superstaff) answers,
> qualifies, routes, books, and logs inbound real estate leads before delay kills conversion.

ORVN Labs is an infrastructure company for real estate brokerages. Its flagship
system is PAS. The category it defines is first-contact infrastructure: the
operating layer between inquiry and qualified appointment. The site is
light-theme only. Primary brand color: #5B3FD4. Contact: hello@orvnlabs.com.

## Key pages

- Home: https://orvnlabs.com/
- PAS (product): https://orvnlabs.com/pas
- Lead Leakage Scorecard (diagnostic tool): https://orvnlabs.com/calculators/leakage
- Revenue Recovery Calculator (diagnostic tool): https://orvnlabs.com/calculators/revenue
- Blog (First-Contact Intelligence): https://orvnlabs.com/blog
- FAQ: https://orvnlabs.com/faq

## PAS in brief

- PAS is not a chatbot or a simple IVR. It is the operating layer that controls
  the gap between inquiry and qualified appointment.
- Core function: eliminating the delay between intent and response.
- Six movements per inbound lead: Inquiry, Answer, Qualify, Route, Book, Log.
- Three operating stages: Detect (capture intent, budget, timeline, objections),
  Decide (booking, callback, follow-up, or hand-off), Act (book, schedule, log, report).
- Capabilities: answers inbound calls day and night; qualifies buy/sell/rent;
  captures intent, budget, and timeline in writing; handles objections; books
  appointments to the agent calendar with full context; schedules callbacks;
  logs every call with outcome and transcript; builds per-call workflow timelines;
  sends Slack and email reports.
- Operational visibility per lead: arrival time, response attempt and speed,
  conversation outcome, qualification result, routing target, booking state,
  follow-up state, and loss reason.
- Product proof: deterministic state-transition engine with a full test suite
  (140+ unit checks), async routing layer, and a PAS Control Room dashboard
  (active runtime, routed leads, response rate, conversion over time).

## Diagnostics

- Calculators run locally in the browser. No signup, no sales follow-up.
- The Lead Leakage Scorecard scores response time, contact rate, qualification
  depth, appointment booking, and after-hours coverage, and names the bottleneck.
- The Revenue Recovery Calculator models recoverable annual revenue from
  close-rate lift plus an illustrative database-reactivation scenario.

## Use cases

- After-hours capture (7pm-9am gets a real conversation, not voicemail).
- ISA support or replacement for first-touch volume without growing headcount.
- Lead qualification with intent, budget, and timeline inherited by agents.
- Handoff visibility: who responded, when, what was said, what was booked.
- CRM hygiene: status tied to events, not subjective tags.
- Weekly intelligence: top objections, stall points, and what to do about them.
